description: The Settings dialog's Dependencies page (Baude's, Record's and the phone's; on the phone the third page of Settings, switched to by the bar at its foot): the programs the host picked beside New session needs for its features, each Installed or the command that installs it on that host, as its deps request says (schema/deps lists them, how each is looked for on macOS and Linux, and its install command per platform); then the app's own (VTE, WebKitGTK on Linux, Node.js), looked for by the app.
opens: Settings… → Dependencies (the dialog's page switcher; the phone's: the bar at Settings' foot)

parts.name: Host
parts.shows: Row "Host" with the picked host's name after it (a computer host: the phone runs none of these).

parts.name: host's dependencies
parts.shows: A boxed list, a row each, in schema/deps' order: the program's name (its own spelling: kubectl), then "Installed" (dim), or the command that installs it on that host (monospace; the phone's wraps to two lines) with a Copy button, or, on a Linux host with no command for its distribution, an Install Page link. The host's error, if it can't be asked, in the list's place.

parts.name: app's dependencies
parts.shows: A group titled with the app's name (Baude, Record): the libraries and programs the app itself needs, rows as above. The phone has none, so shows none.

decisions.said: Think about guidance for installing what Baude depends on (claude, codex, vte3, kubectl, docker) and how Baude behaves when they aren't there (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app lists, per host, what that host's features need and whether it's there, each missing one with the install command for that host's platform, from one table (schema/deps) every app and host reads
